skins.name: Arcade
skins.author: Rondelek
skins.description: The sampler as the app's arcade machine: a navy cabinet with 80s stripe trim, a cyan screen well, rainbow pixel keycaps with embossed letters, neon visualizer bars. Built into the app; the default.

skins.name: Classic
skins.author: Rondelek
skins.description: Flat matte plastic in the EP-133 spirit: neutral light keys with printed labels, one orange accent for REC. Built into the app; the fallback for any file another skin leaves out.
